posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
You have more neural connections than stars in the Milky Way.
But they weaken without the right nutrients.
posts.cta: Your brain is extraordinary — protect it.

bridge_product.name: Pineal Guardian X
bridge_product.description: Liquid formula to eliminate fluoride buildup in the pineal gland, restore natural melatonin production, and improve memory.
bridge_product.audience: Adults experiencing memory loss, brain fog, and age-related cognitive decline.

posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
The prostate is only the size of a walnut — but it surrounds the urethra.
When it swells, it affects every bathroom trip.
posts.cta: A walnut-sized gland with massive impact.

bridge_product.name: TitanFlow
bridge_product.description: Urinary health supplement to strengthen urethra walls and support healthy urinary flow in aging men.
